title: 2024 HMMT February Guts Problem 5
statement:
Let \(a, b\), and \(c\) be real numbers such that

\[\begin{aligned}
a+b+c & =100 \\
a b+b c+c a & =20, \text { and } \\
(a+b)(a+c) & =24
\end{aligned}\]

Compute all possible values of \(b c\).

solutions.text:
We first expand the left-hand-side of the third equation to get \((a+b)(a+c)=a^{2}+a c+\) \(a b+b c=24\). From this, we subtract the second equation to obtain \(a^{2}=4\), so \(a= \pm 2\).
If \(a=2\), plugging into the first equation gives us \(b+c=98\) and plugging into the second equation gives us \(2(b+c)+b c=20 \Rightarrow 2(98)+b c=20 \Rightarrow b c=-176\).
Then, if \(a=-2\), plugging into the first equation gives us \(b+c=102\), and plugging into the second equation gives us \(-2(b+c)+b c=20 \Rightarrow-2(102)+b c=20 \Rightarrow b c=224\).
Therefore, the possible values of \(b c\) are \(224,-176\).
